realistic_final_gate.scope: performance workload only; independent quality gate below

aggregation_scope: repeat 1 only; ordinary median across prompt rates; primary median across prompt-class medians; see per-repeat summaries

requests.reference64_formula: 63 / (t64 - t1), seconds; first 64 generated events, including EOS if event64; null for fewer than64
requests.reference_table_formula: (N-1) / (tN - t1), N=min(64, non-EOS generated events); 63/(t64-t1) at cap; null for N<2
requests.submission100_formula: 99 / (t100 - t1), seconds; first 100 generated events; includes natural EOS at event 100
requests.decode_definition: (N-1)/(tN-t1), N=min(64, non-EOS events); seconds; null for N<2
requests.wall_rate_definition: output events / (request_end - request_start); includes prompt and complete generation, excludes load/reset/teardown
requests.full_completion_definition: (N-1)/(tN-t1) over non-EOS generated events; natural EOS and cap-limited results reported separately
